title: PhasePacket
description: Payload for .cursor/phase.lock. Expected blast radius is authoritative here. .cursor/aar.json must not override it.

phase_id.description: Active phase identifier. The value "manual" is not an audit mode.

allowed_files.description: Edit phases must be non-empty. An empty list is legal only when mode is certify.

base_ref.description: Git revision the emitter and QCA diff against. Defaults to HEAD~1 when omitted.

blast_radius.description: Alias of expected_blast_radius accepted by the auditor.

allow_dirty_base.description: When true, write-lock.mjs may write .cursor/phase.lock while git status --porcelain is non-empty.

override_blast_cap.description: When true, write-lock.mjs may accept an allowed_files array longer than 8.
